name: thesis-mcwm-service-opportunity-v77-20261027
alignment: Native trip/bus ID, line, stop, physical visit occurrence. Align complete logs before selecting visits intersecting the window in either arm. Boundary visits reported separately.
cost_metric: Actual common-window passenger ledger: (2*waiting_person_seconds+ride_person_seconds)/15079; service proxies are not added to ledger costs.
passenger_evidence: Only same-physical-tick inventories. Common arrival queue plus one-arm departure onboard and other-arm still queued is a directly observed service opportunity difference. Compatibility scalar does not establish individual eligibility. Recovery timestamps are observation brackets, not exact boarding times.
information: Retrospective diagnosis only; no model selection from held-out truth or future information used in training. No prediction, simulator, learner or checkpoint import.
downloads: Bounded JSON and necessary short log tails only; passenger IDs and raw logs remain resident.
followup: Identify at most one evidence-backed change for later full-day testing. Do not start simulation or training, scan thresholds, or expand seeds. If evidence cannot localize a change, preserve that result rather than inventing a cause.
